world.title: Trump's ex-lawyer Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
world.description: The vote cements Trump's former criminal defence lawyer as the nation's top law enforcement official despite a rare pushback from some Republicans.

world.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
world.description: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".

world.title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
world.description: Lionel Messi's father and agent Jorge dies at the age of 68 following a long illness.

world.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
world.description: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from  Morocco into the neighbouring Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

world.title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
world.description: The Queen of Pop worked with Orbit several times over the years, most notably on her genre-bending, Grammy Award-winning album Ray of Light.

world.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
world.description: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

world.title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
world.description: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.

world.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
world.description: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.

world.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
world.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

world.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
world.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

world.title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
world.description: The group moved synthetic drugs from Spain to Algeria, then used the return journey to smuggle migrants and weapons.

world.title: NBA forward Clarke's death due to effects of drugs
world.description: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke's death was due to the effects of heroin and cocaine, the Los Angeles medical authority reveals.

world.title: Hunter Biden tells BBC his pardon was 'not good' for US or his father's legacy
world.description: In a wide-ranging BBC interview, the former president's son denies any interest in running for office and says his father's cancer has spread.

world.title: Book hidden in fireplace returned to Australian library 150 years overdue
world.description: It is thought an apprentice stonemason who worked on the Houses of Parliament in London borrowed it.

world.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
world.description: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.

US.title: Ukraine mourns "collector of souls" Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
US.description: Oleksiy Yukov spent two decades recovering the bodies of soldiers – including many Russians. He was killed during a recovery mission after stepping on a landmine.

US.title: K-pop's global wave inspires Chile's next pop stars
US.description: K-pop conquered the world — now Chile's young creatives are remixing the movement and making it their own.

US.title: Opinion: Europe's summer of heat
US.description: Europe is in another brutal heat wave. The summer's earlier record-breaking weather already damaged crops, sparked wildfires and led to increased deaths.

US.title: Switzerland is a neutral nation but has more nuclear bunkers than any country in the world
US.description: Instead of scrapping its network of bomb shelters after the Cold War, Switzerland kept building them. The country has more than 370,000 nuclear bomb shelters. Some are now used to house migrants.

US.title: The Women's Professional Baseball League makes its historic debut
US.description: The Los Angeles Queens, the New York Heights, the Boston Hunters and the San Francisco Firebells take the field in Springfield, Ill., as the Women's Pro Baseball League kicks off its inaugural se

US.title: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
US.description: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants.

US.title: Private prisons announce $1.4 billion in revenue as immigration detentions climb
US.description: That revenue does not include net proceeds of $1.6 billion made by CoreCivic after the recent sale of four of their facilities to the Department of Homeland Security.

US.title: Data centers are a political issue crossing party lines, driving voters to candidates
US.description: Wisconsin Democratic candidate for governor Francesca Hong called for a moratorium on data centers. So did Ohio Republican governor hopeful Vivek Ramaswamy, as data centers begin to dominate campaigns

US.title: Senate votes to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general
US.description: The Senate confirmed Blanche by a 50-49 vote early Saturday morning, elevating President Trump's former personal lawyer to head the Justice Department.

US.title: Staff at the CDC in Atlanta remember victim of shooting a year ago as RFK jr. attends
US.description: It's been a year since a gunman opened fire on the CDC and killed a police officer. RFK Jr. visited the CDC today to remember the victim.
